name: What is the typical process for implementing AEO for a local business?
description: AEO implementation involves an initial audit, AI-driven strategy development, continuous monitoring and adjustments, and regular performance reporting.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for implementing AEO for a local business?

acceptedAnswer.text: The AEO implementation process typically begins with an in-depth audit of your current online presence and local market landscape. Next, AI tools analyze data to identify optimization opportunities and develop a tailored strategy focusing on local search, reputation management, and content. This is followed by continuous AI-driven monitoring and automated adjustments to your campaigns. Regular performance reports and strategic reviews ensure objectives are met, allowing for agile responses to market changes and sustained growth in local visibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO implementation involves an initial audit, AI-driven strategy development, continuous monitoring and adjustments, and regular performance reporting.
